approximation_theory_input: The classical univariate Markov inequality is used as a stated standard theorem; its Bernoulli consequence, separator and adaptive covariance bridge are proved in the prose.
limitations: Exact two-polynomial Boolean-cube formulation only; no general distribution-formulation result is claimed.
All nonzero real multilinear polynomials, all positive integers n,d and degree at most d; full squared L2 norm includes the constant coefficient.
No extension to other underlying groups or approximate disjointness is claimed.
No novelty, priority, external human peer review or formal machine proof is claimed.
The old exponential threshold requires the strict inequality delta < 2^(-d)/d; the non-strict endpoint fails already for d=1.
The necessary inverse-quadratic obstruction in the original report is not a previously proved sufficient threshold.
Finite checks are supplementary; the universal proof has no hidden computational dependency.
The two principal 2026 sources were inspected as arXiv manuscripts; no separately verified journal publication or endorsement of their entire cryptographic contents is claimed.
